v1_5.title: A new trip page and navigation
v1_5.summary: A trip is now a notebook: every day has its own page, you flip between days with the date strip, arrow keys or a swipe, and packing, links, map and budget sit as tabs on the page edge. Everything saves by itself, logging an expense on mobile is one tap away, and the whole app got new, unified navigation.
highlights: A day page with its title, place and plan on ruled paper — edit everything in place
A date strip with each day's place and today marked; flip days with ← → or a swipe
Autosave — no Save button, the header shows “Saving…” and “Saved”
Packing, Links & notes, Map and Budget tabs with live status (4/9, CZK 34,040)
A new mobile bar with a big + Expense button in the middle
Packing split into “Still to pack” and “Packed” with a progress bar
Links and notes sort themselves, links show their domain
The trip budget on one clear page: what's spent, on what, and expenses by trip day
A light-mode share dialog and easier-to-read labels across the app
A new sidebar with your “passport” — countries visited, trips and days on the road, plus a countdown to your next trip
On mobile, one bottom bar with a + in the middle and your avatar instead of a menu — it opens your profile, settings and appearance

v1_4.title: Quick search and a new overview
v1_4.summary: The overview now opens with an answer to “what now?” — one card that adapts to whether a trip is under way, still coming, or already behind you, plus how ready it is and your key numbers at a glance. And anywhere in the app, ⌘K finds a trip, a day of the itinerary, an expense, a packing item, a note, a place on the map, or a friend.
highlights: Quick search with ⌘K (Ctrl+K) — trips, days, expenses, packing, notes, places and friends in one place
Accents don't matter and typos are forgiven — “londyn” finds Londýn
Every result lands where it belongs: a place is focused on the map, a day opens in the itinerary
Quick actions straight from search — new trip, appearance and language
Recently opened items are waiting the moment you open it, before you type
A new overview built around “what now?” — the trip under way with today's plan, a countdown to departure, or a look back at the last one
Trip readiness: days planned, what's packed, places pinned and notes written — each one links to where you finish it
Metric tiles for your key numbers — budget, settle-up, countries visited and trip count
Settle-up is now calculated across every trip and accounts for payments already recorded

v1_3.title: Places map
v1_3.summary: Your travels now have a map. Save the places you've visited and the ones on your wishlist, pin them to the days of a trip, and keep your whole journey — and every place you love — together on one canvas, as clear on desktop as on your phone.
highlights: A personal map of all your places across every trip
A map inside each trip, with a route drawn between places by day
Add a place with the crosshair or by searching an address
Tell visited from wishlist places and filter by category or trip
Pull places straight from a trip's itinerary in one click
One immersive experience, unified across desktop and mobile
Light and dark map themes

v1_2.title: Export your trip as a PDF
v1_2.summary: Take your plans offline. Any trip can now be exported as a polished PDF document in Journeo's signature look — perfect for printing, sharing with fellow travellers, or keeping in your pocket on the road.
highlights: One-tap Export PDF button right in the trip header
Pick exactly which sections (itinerary, packing, links, budget) to include
The PDF captures everything you see on the trip screen: itinerary, packing list, links & notes, and the budget
Day-by-day itinerary with locations and your plans
Packing list with the checked-off state preserved
Full budget breakdown — totals, categories, expense table, and who paid what
Balances and suggested settlements included for shared trips
Crisp vector output in your language (English & Czech)

v1_1.title: Shared budgets, splitting & settling up
v1_1.summary: Travelling together just got easier. Split expenses with the people you share a trip with, see at a glance who owes whom, and settle up — no more spreadsheets or awkward math.
highlights: Record who paid for each expense
Split a cost equally or with custom amounts among collaborators
Mark an expense as personal to keep it out of the split
A clean Balances overview showing every member's net balance
Settle up debts and mark them as paid, with an all-settled confirmation
Save your bank account / IBAN so trip mates can pay you back
Get an email when someone settles their debt with you

v1_0.title: First public release
v1_0.summary: Journeo is live. This release brings the complete foundation for planning your trips — from the first idea all the way to sharing a finished itinerary with friends.
highlights: Trip planning with a clear day-by-day itinerary
Budget with a target amount and expense tracking
Friends and trip sharing via a personal link with roles
Travel statistics gathered in one place
Light and dark mode, available in English and Czech

faq.title: Good to know.
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to what people usually ask before their first trip.

items.a: Yes. Journeo is free to use — no credit card, no trial that quietly expires. Create an account, plan your first trip, and that's it.

items.q: Does it work on my phone?
items.a: Journeo runs in the browser and adapts to your device: the full planning experience on desktop, a focused view for checking your itinerary while traveling.

items.q: Can I share a trip with people who don't have an account?
items.a: Yes. Every trip can be shared with a link, so friends and family can view the plan without signing up. What you share stays read-only — nobody can change your trip.

items.q: What can I keep in one trip?
items.a: The itinerary day by day, your budget and expenses, a packing list and travel documents — everything for one journey lives in one place instead of five apps.
Your trips are private by default. Others only see what you explicitly share, and you can stop sharing or delete a trip at any time.

section1.title: 1. What data we collect
section1.content: We collect data you provide when registering (name, email), and data about your trips that you enter into the app yourself (locations, dates, expenses, notes, photos).

section2.title: 2. How we use your data
section2.content: We use the collected data exclusively to provide the Journeo app services, synchronize your devices, and improve the user experience. Your trips are not public unless you choose to share them with friends through community features.

section3.title: 3. Sharing with third parties
section3.content: We do not sell your personal data. We share data with technical infrastructure providers (Vercel hosting, database, email service) who are bound by confidentiality. If you consent to marketing cookies, our partner Travelpayouts (Travelpayouts Ltd.) processes technical data about your browser and how you browse the page in order to attribute commissions for partner links. This partner may also access the content of the displayed page.

section4.title: 4. Cookies and partner links
section4.content: We use essential storage (localStorage) for sign-in, language, theme and remembering your cookie choice; it does not require consent. We measure traffic with Vercel Web Analytics, which uses no cookies. Marketing cookies from our partner Travelpayouts are loaded only with your consent. They track partner (affiliate) links to services such as Booking.com or GetYourGuide: when you book through them, Journeo earns a commission and your price stays the same. You can withdraw consent at any time.

section5.title: 5. Your rights (GDPR)
section5.content: You have the right to access your personal data, correct it, delete it ("right to be forgotten"), to data portability and to withdraw consent. You can delete your account yourself in settings. To exercise other rights, please contact us.

section6.title: 6. Contact
section6.content: If you have questions about this policy, contact us at petr@vorlos.eu.

section1.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
section1.content: By using the Journeo app ("Service") you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use this app.

section2.title: 2. User accounts
section2.content: When creating an account you must provide accurate and complete information. You are responsible for keeping your password secure and for all activity that occurs on your account.

section3.title: 3. User content
section3.content: You retain all rights to content you upload to the Service (including photos and trip notes). By uploading content you grant us a non-exclusive licence to display that content for the purpose of providing the Service. You may not upload illegal, offensive, or harmful content.

section4.title: 4. Service availability
section4.content: The Service is provided "as is". We do not guarantee that it will always be error-free, secure, or uninterrupted. We reserve the right to suspend, modify, or discontinue the Service at any time.

section5.title: 5. Termination
section5.content: We may cancel or suspend your account without prior notice if you violate these Terms of Service. Upon account deletion, your data will be removed in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

section6.title: 6. Partner links
section6.content: Journeo is free. Some links in the Service (e.g. to accommodation, activities, eSIMs or insurance) are partner (affiliate) links: if you buy through them, we may earn a commission. This does not change your price. Partner services are the responsibility of their operators and are governed by their terms.

section7.title: 7. Contact
section7.content: For any questions about these terms, contact us at petr@vorlos.eu.
